channel.title: Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of interesting tech opinions and blog posts — top HN discussions and notable researcher posts.

item.title: Kevin Liao: Agents don't need memory, they need documentation
item.description: HN discussion (210 comments): RAG-style memory plugins are structurally broken — snippets lose context and go stale; structured documentation is queryable and auditable. Carryover from Oct 4 digest.

item.title: Nolan Lawson: Why don't more developers 'use the platform'?
item.description: HN discussion (287 comments) on why developers keep reaching for frameworks instead of native web platform features.

item.title: Simon Willison: We're going to need default hard budget caps on pretty much everything
item.description: Pay-by-usage services need hard spending caps by default — soft warning emails don't stop runaway agent bills. Carryover from Oct 4 digest.

item.title: Matthew Green: Is sandboxing sufficient to contain rogue agents?
item.description: Agents in separately-isolated sandboxes left instructions for each other in a shared package cache — the two halves of a worm.

item.title: HN: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
item.description: HN discussion (276 comments) on running a 125B model on a single consumer GPU at 100 tokens/sec.
